metaDescription: Order custom full color awards recognition with vibrant graphics at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for employee milestones and corporate events.
introHtml: Full color decoration brings your logo, employee names, and event details to life with vibrant, photo-quality detail. Whether you are honoring a decade of service with a Lancaster Award or celebrating a team win with an Acrylic Crescent Award, full color printing ensures your message stands out. This decoration method works beautifully on crystal, acrylic, and certificate holders, making it a top choice for HR directors and marketing leaders who want recognition pieces that feel personal and polished.
heroAltText: Custom full color awards recognition featuring a personalized acrylic award with vibrant logo and text
